::: {#exm-attention}

#### Attention in PyTorch

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
torch_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
    q.reshape(1, 2), keys, values.reshape(3, 1)
)
by_hand = torch.softmax(keys @ q / math.sqrt(2), dim=0) @ values
print(torch_output, by_hand)
```

The query and keys of @exr-weights have $d_k = 2$,
so [scaled dot-product attention](#def-attention) divides the scores by $\sqrt{2}$ before the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax).
`F.scaled_dot_product_attention` [@pytorch_sdpa] returns `r sprintf("%.2f", py$torch_output$item())`,
the same as the formula computed by hand.
The scaled scores are closer together,
so the average is nearer the plain mean of the values, 20,
than the unscaled average of @sol-weights, `r sprintf("%.2f", py$average$item())`.

:::
